title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint and Viva Insights Integration - Exclusion List for data sharing
description: Viva Glint admins will be able to manage an exclusion list in Viva Feature Access Management that prevents selected people and groups from being included in Viva Insights data shared with Viva Glint. This simplifies configuration and helps organizations apply consistent, privacy-conscious controls for the integration.
